title: Vegan Plant-Based Board
seo_title: Vegan Charcuterie Board for 8–12: Cashew Cheese, Tempeh & Plan
description: A vegan charcuterie board for 8–12: cashew brie, vegan cheddar, herbed cashew cheese, smoked tofu, tempeh, hummus, baba ganoush, fruit and crackers.
hook: Zero animal products, bold flavors: three plant-based cheeses, smoky proteins and four dips that nobody has to make allowances for.
why: Cashew-based cheeses work because cashews are rich and creamy in the same way dairy is, so a cashew brie spreads and melts on the tongue like the real thing. A vegan cheddar adds the firm, sharp option.

Smoked tofu and marinated tempeh bring the savory, smoky depth that cured meat usually does, and roasted chickpeas add crunch. Four dips (hummus, baba ganoush, tapenade and fig jam) cover earthy, smoky, salty and sweet.

timeline.what: Take the vegan cheeses out of the fridge.
Slice the tempeh and tofu; prep the vegetables.
Place the cheeses and fill the dip bowls.
Add the proteins, fruit, crackers and nuts.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve.

faq.q: What goes on a vegan charcuterie board?
faq.a: Cashew or other plant-based cheeses, smoked tofu, marinated tempeh, roasted chickpeas, hummus, baba ganoush, tapenade, fruit, vegetables, crackers and nuts.

faq.q: What can replace meat on a vegan board?
faq.a: Smoked tofu, marinated tempeh, roasted chickpeas and marinated mushrooms bring the savory, smoky flavor cured meat usually adds.
Many are, but some contain butter, milk or honey. Check the label.
